## Files to download

Download the [complete repository ZIP](https://github.com/anetaarct/thermal-conditions-reproduction-cf-publication/archive/refs/heads/main.zip) and keep its folder structure.

- **Weather and window inputs:** [daily SMHI temperatures](data_derived/smhi_hoburg_daily_temperature.csv), [annual window means](data_derived/annual_main_window_temperature.csv), [annual median laying dates](data_derived/annual_raw_median_laying_date.csv).
- **Saved model output for tables and figures:** all CSV files in `tables/final_models_20261019/`, `tables/primary_ZIyear_ML_20261021/` and `tables/temporal_models_20261022/` (included in the ZIP).
- **Analysis and figure code:** `R/` and `scripts/` (included in the ZIP). Figure scripts are shown in the [final chapter](figure_code.qmd).

<details class="analysis-code">
<summary>Private files required by the retained model scripts</summary>

The filenames below are read by the original scripts. They are **not included in the public ZIP**. Paths are relative to the original analysis directory, unless an absolute path is shown.

| File | Used by |
|---|---|
| `glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/clutch_counts/data.rds` | Clutch verification and temporal refit |
| `glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/clutch_counts/COM_predictors_bounded.rds` | Starting fit for clutch verification |
| `glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/clutch_counts/COM_selected.rds` | Existing selected clutch fit; read by temporal/export scripts and copied by verification |
| `/home/arct/CF_thermal_phenology_run/data_derived/clutch_size_model_data.csv` | Original centring values for clutch prediction export |
| `glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/analysis_data.rds` | Curated fledging dataset |
| `glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/M1_selected.rds` | Starting fit for the fledging extension |
| `zi_year_sensitivity_20261020/zi_year_selected.rds` | Selected fledging fit; produced by script 81, read by scripts 82 and 83 |

| `year_without_temperature_20261022/fledging_selected.rds` | Selected temporal fledging fit; produced by script 83, read by script 84 |

The raw-field import/cleaning script and original sliding-window script/cache are still needed for a rerun from the original database. The retained scripts preserve their historical paths and must be adapted to the local analysis directory.

</details>

## Load the curated breeding datasets

The analyses used already curated `.rds` files. The loading paths below come from the temporal-fitting script; individual records remain private.

<details class="analysis-code" open>
<summary>Show R code</summary>

```r
clutch_data <- readRDS(
  "glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/clutch_counts/data.rds"
)
fledging_data <- readRDS(
  "glmmTMB_comparison_20261016/analysis_data.rds"
)
str(clutch_data)
str(fledging_data)
```

</details>

**Saved sample counts**

| Analysis | Breeding attempts | Females | Seasons |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Clutch size | 12,627 | 8,894 | 1981–2025, excluding 2020 |
| Egg-to-fledging success | 9,790 | 7,132 | 1981–2019 |

Laying-date input covers 45 seasons; weather covers all 46 years, 1980–2025.

## Load the saved SMHI observations

Daily mean air temperatures came from Hoburg (68550) and Hoburg A (68560), Sweden. The publication uses the saved snapshot below.

<details class="analysis-code" open>
<summary>Show R code</summary>

```r
library(readr)
daily <- read_csv("data_derived/smhi_hoburg_daily_temperature.csv")
annual <- read_csv("data_derived/annual_main_window_temperature.csv")
phenology <- read_csv("data_derived/annual_raw_median_laying_date.csv")
head(daily)
head(annual)
```

</details>

[Download CSV](data_derived/annual_main_window_temperature.csv)
<details class="analysis-code">
<summary>SMHI download code (new recipe; not the archived downloader)</summary>

[SMHI source and station catalogue](https://opendata-download-metobs.smhi.se/api/version/latest/parameter/2.json). This example saves fresh archives separately; it does not replace the publication snapshot.

```r
stations <- c(Hoburg = 68550, Hoburg_A = 68560)
dir.create("data_raw/smhi", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (name in names(stations)) {
  url <- sprintf(paste0(
    "https://opendata-download-metobs.smhi.se/api/version/1.0/",
    "parameter/2/station/%s/period/corrected-archive/data.csv"
  ), stations[[name]])
  download.file(url, file.path("data_raw/smhi", paste0(name, ".csv")),
                mode = "wb")
}
```


</details>

## Software versions

The final reproductive-model documentation records **R 4.6.1** and **glmmTMB 1.1.14**. Session logs are not included, so these versions are reported from that documentation; the original sliding-window R version is unconfirmed. Paths mentioning R 4.5 identify library folders, not an independently verified runtime.

<details class="analysis-code">
<summary>Show R code</summary>

```r
R.version.string
packageVersion("glmmTMB")
sessionInfo()
# Save alongside a model when rerunning locally:
capture.output(sessionInfo(), file = "session_info.txt")
```

</details>

## Display results without refitting

Model pages read saved result tables. Loading a local fitted object is also possible without calling the optimiser:

<details class="analysis-code">
<summary>Show R code</summary>

```r
model <- readRDS("zi_year_sensitivity_20261020/zi_year_selected.rds")
summary(model)
# Public alternative, used for the displayed coefficient table:
fixed <- read.csv("tables/primary_ZIyear_ML_20261021/ZIyear_fixed.csv")
fixed
```

</details>
